title: Anywhere Cache 'pause' method removed; Rapid Cache info added
summary: The `anywhereCaches.pause` method has been removed from the Cloud Storage API, which is a breaking change for integrations managing Anywhere Cache instances. Additionally, the `BucketStorageLayout` schema now includes `rapidCacheInfo` to expose details about Rapid Cache configurations.
details: Developers using the `storage.v1` API should note the removal of the `anywhereCaches.pause` method. This method, along with its `bucket` and `anywhereCacheId` parameters, is no longer available, meaning any code attempting to pause Anywhere Cache instances will now fail. Please update your integrations to remove calls to this method. On the feature front, the `BucketStorageLayout` schema has been extended with a new `rapidCacheInfo` object. This object contains a `cacheType` property, which will indicate the type of cache (e.g., `rapid-cache`, `rapid-cache-ultra`) if a Rapid Cache is present for the bucket. This provides more visibility into your bucket's storage layout and caching configurations.
